experiment_name: Decomposing 023's HYBRID_COMPAT improvement into BUY_PROPERTY/ACCEPT_TRADE, crippled vs. repaired peers

algorithm_config.reused_from_023: SEEDS/MAX_ROUNDS/NUM_SEATS/CHECKPOINT_PATH/BASELINE_CHECKPOINT_SHA256/verify_baseline_checkpoint/_arm_summary/intervention_audit all imported directly from monopolyzero_hybrid_bootstrap_isolation_audit (023's own module, as audit_v1) - not redefined
algorithm_config.context_1_crippled_peers: other 3 seats POLICY_ONLY (023's exact setup). POLICY_ONLY and BOTH arms deterministically regenerated (same seeds/checkpoint/game-loop as 023) and reconciled bit-for-bit against 023's own logged aggregate values before anything was reported - not a new/different measurement of those two arms, just mechanically reproduced to recover the per-game records 023's log never persisted. BUY_ONLY and TRADE_ONLY run fresh.
algorithm_config.context_2_repaired_peers: other 3 seats HYBRID_COMPAT(BOTH) instead of POLICY_ONLY. All 4 arms (POLICY_ONLY, BUY_ONLY, TRADE_ONLY, BOTH) fresh. BOTH arm's focus seat uses the identical policy config as its 3 peers, so one self-play game per seed (20 games, not 80) yields all 4 seats' paired records - decision-seed mixing depends only on (seed, turn_index, seat), never on which seat is labeled focus, so this is mathematically identical to 80 separately-focused games.
algorithm_config.primary_stats: seed_block_paired_randomization_test (exact enumeration, 2^20 sign patterns) + paired_seed_block_bootstrap (win-rate and net-worth diff, n_resamples=2000, bootstrap_seed=0), both from evaluation_protocol.py, each arm vs. that context's own POLICY_ONLY reference arm

result: Reconciliation against 023 was EXACT: context 1's regenerated POLICY_ONLY and BOTH arms matched 023's own logged aggregate values with zero delta on every deterministic field (win rate, wins, bankruptcy, mean/median net worth, round-cap rate, wins-by-seat) - confirming these are genuinely 023's own result, mechanically reproduced, not a new/different measurement. Context 1 (crippled POLICY_ONLY peers, 023's exact setup): BUY_ONLY alone recovers 76.5% of BOTH's win-rate improvement (+16.25pp vs. +21.25pp) and 92.8% of its net-worth improvement, with both PRIMARY stats excluding zero (randomization p=0.00098, bootstrap CI [10.0,22.5]pp); TRADE_ONLY alone recovers 29.4% of the win-rate improvement (+6.25pp) but the two PRIMARY stats disagree on significance here - the randomization test's p=0.0625 exceeds the conventional 0.05 threshold while the bootstrap's win-rate-diff 95% CI [1.25,11.25]pp barely excludes zero; both figures are reported as-is, no cherry-pick. BUY_ONLY's effect (+16.25pp) plus TRADE_ONLY's effect (+6.25pp) sum to +22.5pp, close to BOTH's actual +21.25pp (both_minus_sum=-1.25pp) - read as approximately additive, i.e. the two fixes are largely independent contributions against crippled peers, with BUY_PROPERTY clearly the dominant one. Context 2 (repaired HYBRID_COMPAT(BOTH) peers): against tougher, non-crippled opponents, the overall win rate for every arm drops sharply (POLICY_ONLY 7.5% vs. its own 25.0% in context 1), and neither BUY_ONLY (+3.75pp, p=0.590, CI crosses zero [-5.0,12.5]pp) nor TRADE_ONLY (+2.5pp, p=0.625, CI crosses zero [-2.5,7.5]pp) individually clears statistical significance at this sample size (n=20 seed blocks) - only the full BOTH combination does (+17.5pp, p=0.00052, CI [11.25,22.5]pp excluding zero). BOTH's effect (+17.5pp) substantially exceeds the sum of the two individual effects (+6.25pp, both_minus_sum=+11.25pp) - read as super-additive/positive synergy: against competent opponents, having BOTH fixes together appears to matter far more than either alone, though neither alone is individually confirmed at this n. Intervention rates ranged 1.9%-10.3% of non-forced decisions across arms/contexts (highest for BOTH, as expected - it is the only arm where both carve-outs can fire on the same trajectory). Zero illegal actions, zero crashes, zero incomplete games across all 580 physical games (320 context 1 + 260 context 2, the context-2 BOTH arm's self-play optimization confirmed via a decision-count cross-check: its 85,404 recorded per-decision latencies match 20 self-play games x ~4,270 decisions/game x 4 seats, not 80 separately-run games). No promotion/GO-KILL verdict is computed - these numbers are for a human to read.
notes: The raw stdout's config.games_run field reports {context_1: 320, context_2: 320} - a bug present in the script AT RUN TIME that summed paired-record counts (4 per physical game for the self-play-optimized context_2 BOTH arm) rather than physical games executed. This is a purely descriptive/reporting field; it does not affect any deterministic game outcome, the exact-match reconciliation against 023, or any statistic in this log - confirmed via the decision-count cross-check described in the result field. Fixed in the script (commit a453cf7) for future runs, with a regression test, but this experiment was NOT re-run for that cosmetic fix given ~2 hours of compute already produced fully valid, reconciled results; this log's counts/algorithm_config fields report the corrected {context_1: 320, context_2: 260} physical-game figures by hand. context_1's policy_only total_non_forced_decisions is null because build_local_policy_only carries no .log (it never intervenes by construction, so an intervention count is trivially zero/not applicable, not unmeasured).
